versions.changelog:
- 3.0.0.0: Breaking change: retire GET /Driftfin/Config secret sharing.
  Upgrade Driftfin clients first. Add managed integrations, capabilities,
  diagnostics and user-scoped unified discovery. Preserve saved configuration.
- 2.0.0.0: Rebuild for Jellyfin 12 and .NET 10. Older servers retain
  plugin 1.0.2.0; the plugin identity and saved configuration are unchanged.
  Fix Watch Together chat for users without remote-control permission and
  require group membership before relaying messages.
- 1.0.2.0: Add a server-wide "Local (LAN) URL" setting that Driftfin clients
  on the local network adopt automatically.
- 1.0.1.0: Fix /Driftfin/Config and SyncPlay message relay returning 500 on
  Jellyfin 10.11 by dropping the removed "DefaultAuthorization" policy name
  in favor of plain [Authorize].
- 1.0.0.0: Initial release. Serves Seerr/Sonarr/Radarr/Trakt config via
  GET /Driftfin/Config and an admin dashboard page.

name: Driftfin
description: Connects Driftfin to Seerr, Sonarr and Radarr through authenticated Jellyfin endpoints while keeping integration credentials on the server. The Driftfin app works fully without this plugin.
overview: Managed integrations and unified discovery for Driftfin.
